name: Redundant Assignment
hint: The finder detects an assignment whose value is never observed before another assignment, either on every control-flow path or on some paths. The write is therefore unnecessary or obscures which state the program intends to use.
instruction: Trace the variable or attribute through each relevant branch and use; remove the write when no read can observe it, or move it or add the needed use before it is overwritten.
